faq.heading: Common questions
faq.subtitle: The most common questions about how Pesan AI helps your business reply to customer chats and handle booking flows automatically.

items.question: What is Pesan AI?
items.answer: Pesan AI is a WhatsApp AI Agent platform that helps businesses reply to customer chats automatically, naturally, and in real time, while handling booking flows without manual intervention.

items.question: Can this AI really be customized?
items.answer: Yes. Pesan AI can be customized almost 100% for your business needs. From conversation flow and communication style to booking rules and service personalization, everything can be configured. The chat platform remains WhatsApp, but the entire in-chat experience can be tailored.

items.question: Is Pesan AI suitable for all business types?
items.answer: Yes. Pesan AI works well for many businesses that need fast responses and booking workflows, including clinics, salons, service businesses, SMEs, and other professional services.

items.question: Will customers know they are talking to AI?
items.answer: Pesan AI is designed to respond naturally and politely like a human assistant. You can also tune the communication tone to match your brand voice.

items.question: How does the automated booking system work?
items.answer: The AI asks for customer details, checks schedule availability, and informs whether a booking slot is available. If a slot is full, the AI can automatically recommend alternative available times.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to use Pesan AI?
items.answer: No. You only need to use the provided web chat. For AI setup, conversation flow, and system configuration, you can discuss everything with our team and we will prepare it for you. You simply use it with a ready-to-use account.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.introductionText: Welcome to Pesan AI ("we," "our," or "us"). We are an intelligent messaging and automation platform powered by the WhatsApp Business API. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy informs you how we look after your personal data and your customers' messaging data when you use our services.
PrivacyPage.collectionIntro: We may collect, use, store, and transfer different kinds of data necessary to operate our platform:

collectionItems.label: Identity and Contact Data:
collectionItems.value: Includes your name, email address, WhatsApp phone numbers, business profiles, and login credentials.

collectionItems.label: Messaging and Customer Data:
collectionItems.value: Includes message content, conversation history, customer contacts, and interaction data processed through our platform.

collectionItems.label: Technical Data:
collectionItems.value: Includes internet protocol (IP) address, login data, browser types, webhook payloads, API integrations, and operating systems.

collectionItems.label: Usage Data:
collectionItems.value: Includes information about how you use our website, messaging metrics, and AI automation interactions.

PrivacyPage.usageIntro: We use your personal and operational data primarily in the following circumstances:
usageItems: To operate and provide WhatsApp Business messaging and automation services.
To process AI interactions in your customer conversations based on your configurations.
To manage your account and provide technical customer support.
To improve our AI algorithms, user interface, and overall platform reliability.
To comply with Meta/WhatsApp's operational guidelines and applicable local regulations.
PrivacyPage.securityText: We implement robust industry-standard security measures to protect your business communication and personal data against unauthorized access. AI-processed conversations are handled securely, and access to your conversation history is restricted strictly to you and your authorized team members.
PrivacyPage.contactText: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data management practices, please contact our support team through the Pesan AI website.

TermsPage.ipText: The Pesan AI website, platform, original content, database structure, and AI models are and will remain the exclusive property of our platform. You are not granted any license to use our trademarks without prior written consent.
TermsPage.obligationsIntro: When registering and utilizing our platform, you agree not to:

WebhookDocsDialog.title: Webhook API Documentation
WebhookDocsDialog.description: How your webhook endpoint should handle incoming requests from pesan-ai.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.p1: Every request includes a bearer token in the <authCode>Authorization</authCode> header. The token is a short-lived JWT signed with the <strongAuth>HS256</strongAuth> algorithm using your configured <strongPassphrase>passphrase</strongPassphrase> as the shared secret.
auth.p2: If your webhook tool asks for JWT credentials, configure the key type as <strongType>passphrase</strongType>, choose <strongAlgo>HS256</strongAlgo> as the algorithm, and use the exact passphrase entered when creating the webhook in pesan-ai.

validation.title: Validation Request
validation.p1: When you register a webhook, pesan-ai sends a <strongGet>GET</strongGet> request to your URL to verify it is reachable and can authenticate. Your endpoint must validate the JWT token and return a <codeOk>200 OK</codeOk> response to confirm the webhook is valid.

message.title: Message Request
message.p1: When a new message is received, pesan-ai forwards it to your webhook via a <strongPost>POST</strongPost> request. Your endpoint should verify the JWT bearer token using your configured passphrase, process the message history, and return a bot response.
message.p2: The <codePhone>customerPhoneNumber</codePhone> field identifies the customer, and the <codeMessages>messages</codeMessages> array contains text messages in chronological order.

list.phone: <codeField>customerPhoneNumber</codeField>: customer WhatsApp phone number in international format.

message.p3: The <codeBot>botResponse</codeBot> field is optional and will be sent to the customer as a bot message. <codeAdmin>adminTakeover</codeAdmin> is optional and defaults to <codeFalse>false</codeFalse>; when set to <codeTrue>true</codeTrue>, pesan-ai marks the conversation for admin takeover before sending the bot response.
message.p4: Return a non-2xx status only when pesan-ai should treat the webhook call as failed. Client errors are not retried, except <code429>429</code429>. Rate limits and server errors are retried up to 3 times with a 1 second linear delay.
